title: What happens to TMC's ₹1,000-crore assets amid split? Aroop Biswas seeks account freeze
description: The TMC has assets worth ₹1,081.78 crore, according to the 2024-25 audit report submitted with the Election Commission. This includes ₹625.78 crore is in bank accounts besides ₹250.77 crore in investments and ₹50 crore in cheque.
